annotations.title: Search FDA medical device clearances (510(k), PMA)

description: FDA medical device 510(k) clearances and PMA approvals: applicant, contact person, address, device and generic name, product code, specialty panel, device class, dates received and decided, review days, decision and links. Filter by date, company, device words, product code, specialty and class. Use for medtech competitive intelligence and sales prospecting. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/fda-device-clearances on your Apify account (about $0.004 per decision; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

decided_within_days.description: Decisions in the last N days.

device_name.description: Words in the device or trade name, e.g. "catheter".

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

name: search_fda_device_clearances

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.
